name: @tagents/plugin-telegram
description: Personal Claude Code orchestrator over Telegram forum topics: one session per topic, parallel turns, a wake spool for background jobs, a message-claim registry

scripts.pretest: test -f node_modules/@tagents/core/dist/index.js || { echo 'build @tagents/core first: pnpm -C ../../tagents/packages/core build' >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.check: for f in src/*.mjs test/*.mjs test/contract/*.mjs; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; node --check "$f" || exit 1; done; for f in ensure.sh scripts/*.sh; do bash -n "$f" || exit 1; done
